scope: Future targeted startup, migration and update validation; no execution in this task
allowed_future_executable_changes: only after a new user instruction; this document authorizes none

cases.acceptance_criterion: New package; Enabled=false; read actual task state and UI; no Run write; ordinary Start launch shows Studio.
Operate the dedicated control; actual StartupTask state follows successful requests; no force or Registry fallback; retain --silent for startup only.

cases.environment: Windows 11 GitHub where Startup settings UI is available
cases.acceptance_criterion: Disable this test task using Windows' supported UI; refocus preferences; display false/disabled-by-user and do not re-enable. If UI unavailable, mark not executed, not pass.
Inject DisabledByPolicy, EnabledByPolicy and Unknown; lock/describe controls correctly. This is simulated policy coverage, not an OS policy test.

cases.scope: No startup side effects from profiles
cases.acceptance_criterion: Import profiles with LaunchAtLogin true/false; load, normalize, change color and reopen preferences; task state unchanged and zero OS-mutation requests. Explicit switch action remains separate.

cases.environment: Distinct authorized Windows session; orchestration not yet established
cases.acceptance_criterion: After opt-in, log on to a new session; task starts exactly one process with --silent, no splash/Studio. After opt-out, no process starts. Manual --silent launch or API enable alone cannot satisfy this case.

Place known non-personal 2.7.0-format profile in actual legacy directory; import by app UI; verify original file bytes/path intact and independent target in LocalState; compare fields with expected defaults for new keys. This fixture alone does not prove an installed-2.7.0 migration.
Main invalid with valid .bak, both invalid, inaccessible, and >1,000,000-byte input: correct recovery/refusal, bounded read, no rename/delete/write to any source.
Old same-family LocalCache profile and different legacy profile both present: take package profile; preserve language/tool cycle; do not scan other preview identities.

Existing LocalState main or backup prevents automatic overwrite; corrupt destination uses local recovery, not silent legacy fallback; second launch does not repeat migration. Explicit trial/diagnostic path guards reject overlapping LocalState, same-family LocalCache and legacy roots; no migration or startup mutation occurs in those modes.
Injected failure before commit leaves originals/current profile intact; pending old saves cannot overwrite committed import; retry does not duplicate or overwrite unexpectedly.

Referenced PNG/WAV copied only with consent; hashes match, new paths inside package data; missing/too-large/unsupported file shown before commit; raw source profile unchanged and preset status coherent.

cases.environment: Windows 11 GitHub with preserved 2.7.0 executable available
cases.acceptance_criterion: Use exact preserved 2.7.0 binary and recorded hash; verify one shared instance lock and read-only real maintenance lock. Refuse second engine without forced stop or changes to old Run/installation. Missing trusted binary or blocked launch => not executed; no reconstruction of stable or protection bypass.

cases.scope: Preview7 wrapper A to new-binary wrapper B
cases.environment: Windows 11 GitHub same disposable package family
cases.acceptance_criterion: Same Name/Publisher/architecture/AppId, increasing package version; close A cleanly, update directly, no Remove-AppxPackage between A/B. Observe B version, LocalCache->LocalState migration, languages/tools/all fields, original source intact.

cases.scope: Wrapper B to wrapper C, same new binary
cases.acceptance_criterion: Only package version increases; EXE hash identical B/C. Keep profile and TaskId; verify LocalState data and startup state preserved, no migration replay or enable reset; restart and clean shutdown.
Refuse update on unclosed app or use supported deferred deployment; never force kill. Failure is recorded as failure, existing registration/profile preserved; no uninstall/reinstall workaround.

cases.environment: Distinct disposable Windows environment, only after explicit test authorization
cases.acceptance_criterion: Install the exact preserved 2.7.0 package if permitted; configure non-personal profile, quit normally, migrate into new MSIX and inspect original installation, preferences and custom assets. Do not substitute fixture M1 for this result; if protections block, stop and record not executed.

environment_rules: GitHub-hosted disposable machines or separately authorized distinct Windows environment only
No local execution, install or configuration on the user's PC
No protection bypass, no signing, no certificate creation
Do not change system policy to fabricate policy-state tests
No installer or SDK installation unless separately authorized; use existing runner tools first
No logoff/reboot of a runner unless a reliable distinct-session continuation has been established and authorized
No workflows or dispatch created by this preparation

update_fixture.publisher: same unsigned test Publisher for A/B/C; never production identity
update_fixture.C_binary_rule: same as B; no third compilation

evidence_requirements: actual OS/build/architecture, test identity and package version
EXE SHA256 before/after packaging and installed execution
real app-data path and startup state; personal paths redacted from public logs
original legacy/profile SHA before/after, destination SHA and semantic field comparison
explicit expected changes: defaults for absent 2.7.0 fields, accepted asset path changes; no startup activation from import
clean exit code; actual update or explicitly not executed
separate actual OS results from service-double simulations
no complete personal profile/screenshot content in public logs

existing_proof_reused.coverage_warning: No prior run validates real logon, installed legacy migration or same-identity update.
